name: Hardships Of A Vampire
source:
Oliver was dealt a bad card at life. Being a poor orphan, he studied hard to aim for his big break. But now, he is stuck at a night shift job making minimum wage, without any escape in sight. What is a vampire to do?

It turned out there were two people perfectly willing to help him: A flirty regular customer , and his way-too-perfect co-worker. But, they also had secrets of their own. Are they trustworthy?

[From [url=https://saitoki.itch.io/hardship]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奥利弗在生活中遇到了一张糟糕的牌。作为一个贫穷的孤儿，他努力学习，以期取得重大突破。但现在，他却被困在一份拿着最低工资的夜班工作中，看不到任何出路。吸血鬼该做什么？

事实证明，有两个人非常愿意帮助他：一个是轻浮的常客，另一个是他过于完美的同事。但是，他们也有自己的秘密。他们值得信赖吗？

[来自[url=https://saitoki.itch.io/hardship]itch.io[/url]]
